title: niphobolus splendens
intro: Niphobolus splendens, commonly known as Polypodium splendens, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine, particularly in Asia, for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Niphobolus splendens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy of Niphobolus splendens for its claimed health benefits and therapeutic actions.
